newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end higher on Petrobras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end higher on Petrobras.

text.p: Brazil shares closed up 0.48 percent with Petrobras spearheading the rise amid investor sparring ahead of Monday's options settlements, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most traded shares ended up 325 points at 67,660 points. Volume was moderate at 487 million reais ($475.3 million).

Petrobras preferred share rose 4.67 percent to close at 133.98 percent on heavy foreign buying on news it signed a $4.8 billion investment agreement to build a petrochemical complex in Sao Paulo state.
The common share rose 4.22 percent to end at 83.90 reais.
Bellwether Telebras preferred share closed at 82.30 reais, up 0.49 percent. Mining giant Vale do Rio Doce preferred share was traded at 20.85 reais, up 0.48 percent.
Among the big losers, federal power utility company Eletrobras preferred share ended off 1.19 percent at 333 reais.
